export.started: The export has started. You can leave this page; it keeps running.
export.readyBody: Made {when}, {size}. You can download it until {expires}.
export.confirmDelete: Delete this archive now? It cannot be downloaded afterwards.
export.problems: One problem was found | {count} problems were found

problems.media_missing: A media file ({id}) had no stored bytes. Its details are in the archive, its content is not.

errors.transfer_busy: This site already has an export or import running. Try again when it has finished.
errors.transfer_archive_gone: The archive has expired or was deleted.
errors.forbidden: Only administrators can export and import sites.
errors.unknown: The request could not be completed. Try again.
errors.transfer_too_large: The archive is larger than this installation accepts as an upload. Ask the operator to use the "sites import" command.
errors.transfer_warnings_not_accepted: The check found warnings. Accept them to import.
errors.transfer_invalid_options: These options cannot be used for this import.
errors.transfer_check_expired: The check is more than 24 hours old. Upload the archive again.
errors.transfer_target_changed: The site changed since the check. Check the archive again.
errors.sites_host_name_taken: That host name is already used by another site.
errors.site_import_in_progress: This site is being imported into. Try again when the import has finished.
errors.transfer_confirmation_mismatch: The name you typed does not match the site’s name.
errors.transfer_restore_not_allowed: This archive was not exported from this site, so it cannot restore it.

import.heading: Import a site
import.subtitle: Create a new site from an archive exported by this or another installation. The archive is checked first; nothing changes until you confirm.
import.refused: This archive cannot be imported. Nothing was changed.
import.name: Name of the new site
import.hostName: Host name of the new site
import.hostNameHelp: Every host name of the archive is used by another site here, so the new site needs one of its own.
import.startFresh: Start fresh: import content as unpublished drafts, without history
import.acceptWarnings: I have read the warnings above and want to import anyway

check.sameSite: This archive was exported from this site.
check.errors: One problem stops the import | {count} problems stop the import
check.hostNamesLeftOut: Host names used by another site here, which will not be added
check.pastSchedules: Schedules whose time has passed, which will not run

report.heading: Import finished
report.droppedSchedules: Schedules dropped because their time had passed
report.historicalAuthors: One author of the archive is not a user here; their name is kept as history. | {count} authors of the archive are not users here; their names are kept as history.

reasons.media_missing: its content was not in the archive
reasons.media_refused: its type is not accepted here

banner.importing: This site is being imported into. Changes are paused until it finishes (started at {when}).
banner.finished: The import has finished. Reload to see the site as it is now.

merge.heading: Import into this site
merge.intro: Add an archive’s content to this site. Nothing is removed, and host names and availability stay as they are.
merge.policy: When the archive and this site both have a document

replace.label: Replace
replace.help: — this site’s document keeps its place and takes the archive’s content; its earlier versions stay in its history.

skip.label: Skip
skip.help: — this site’s document stays as it is, and the archive’s content refers to it.

rename.label: Rename
rename.help: — the archive’s document is added beside it under a new address or name.

restore.heading: Restore from archive
restore.intro: Make this site match an archive exported from it. Content the archive does not hold is removed.
restore.title: Restore “{name}” from this archive?
restore.body: The site will match the archive. Host names and availability do not change.
restore.removals: Nothing is removed | One document is removed | {count} documents are removed
restore.returns: Nothing comes back | One document comes back | {count} documents come back
restore.changes: Nothing changes | One document changes | {count} documents change
restore.backupFirst: The site as it is now is exported first and kept for 7 days, so you can undo the restore.
restore.typeName: Type the site name, {name}, to confirm
restore.nameMismatch: The name does not match. Type it exactly as shown.

trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Deleted pages, components, items and files of {site}. Restore one, or let it be deleted permanently on the date shown.
trash.loadFailed: The trash could not be loaded.
trash.empty: Nothing in the trash. Deleted pages, components, items and files stay here for {days} days.

parent.gone: Under a page that is gone

folder.gone: In a folder that is gone

restore.title: Restore {label}

placement.with_parents: Restore its parent pages as well

restore.addressChanged: The address {old} is taken; it will be restored as {new}.
restore.becomesHome: It will become the home page.
restore.templateDropped: It will no longer be the template of its collection.
restore.folderGone: Its folder is gone; it will go to the top level of the library.
restore.wasLive: This was live when it was deleted. It comes back unpublished.
restore.wasScheduled: This was scheduled to publish when it was deleted. It comes back unpublished, without its schedule.
restore.changed: Something changed while you were deciding. Check where it goes now.
restore.notInTrash: This is no longer in the trash. It may have been restored or deleted permanently.
restore.placementRequired: Where this was is in the trash or gone. Choose where to restore it.
restore.needsAttention: It will be marked as needing attention for these fields:

trash.movedToTrash: Moved to the trash. It can be restored until {date}.

lockHeld.message: {name} is editing this, since {since}. You can delete it when they have finished, or once their editing has been idle for 30 minutes.

emptyTrash.title: Empty the trash?
emptyTrash.body: {total} entries will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
emptyTrash.changed: The trash changed while you were deciding. Check the new count.
emptyTrash.failed: The trash could not be emptied. Entries not yet deleted can still be restored.

purge.label: Delete permanently: {label}
purge.confirm: Delete {label} permanently? This cannot be undone.
purge.confirmFile: Delete {label} permanently? The file stops existing in storage. This cannot be undone.

bulk.failed: The selected entries could not be restored.
bulk.purgeConfirm: Delete {n} entries permanently? This cannot be undone.

preview.banner: In the trash, deleted by {name} on {date}.

preview.noTemplate: This collection has no template page, so its items cannot be previewed.

share.title: Share a preview
share.intro: Anyone with the link can view this {target} without signing in, until it expires. Links always show the latest saved draft.
share.introVersion: Anyone with the link can view version {number} without signing in, until it expires.
share.label: Label (optional)
share.labelHelp: For example, Client review. Only members see it.
share.created: This link is shown only once. Anyone with it can view this {target} until {expiry}.
share.revokeConfirm: Revoke this link? Anyone using it will see that it is no longer available.
share.limit: This {kind} has 20 active links. Revoke one to create another.

errors.link_limit: This page or item already has 20 active links. Revoke one first.
errors.invalid_expiry: Choose an expiry after now and at most 30 days ahead.
errors.invalid_label: The label can be at most 80 characters.
errors.no_template: This collection has no template page, so its items cannot be previewed.
errors.version_not_retained: This version is no longer kept.
errors.not_found: This page or item no longer exists.
errors.generic: The link could not be created. Try again.

links.title: Preview links
links.intro: Every active preview link of this site. Anyone with a link can view its page or item without signing in until it expires.
links.revokeAllConfirm: Revoke all {count} active preview links of this site?

preview.lastSaved: The preview shows the last saved draft. Save to preview your latest changes.
